samples.question: The image shows three square panels side by side. Each panel is ruled into the same 7 by 7 grid of cells, and some of its cells are filled. Imagine stacking the three panels exactly on top of one another so that their grids line up cell for cell. In the stack, mark a cell when it is filled in an odd number of the three panels (that is, in exactly one or in all three), and leave it blank when it is filled in an even number of them (that is, in none or in exactly two). The marked cells of the stack form a shape that most closely matches one of these five symbols: arrow, chevron, ell, hourglass, ring. Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
